sensitivity_role: figure-derived geometry may assess robustness but can never replace primary source geometry

source.citation: Resendiz-Infante & Gauthier 2024, Frontiers in Bird Science
source.figure: Figure 1 map of spring stopovers and breeding grounds

digitization_protocol: use the highest-resolution original Figure 1 raster from the publisher
georeference only from map graticule / coastline control points visible in the published figure
digitize St_Lawrence, Nunavik, and Baffin boundaries without loading GPS outcomes, climate-q values, or model residuals
perform two independent traces before comparing them
rasterize both traces onto the native ~32 km NARR grid
compute grid-cell Jaccard agreement separately for each route region

acceptance_gate.if_passed: retain both traces; do not average boundaries using GPS data

forbidden: do not call digitized polygons the authors' exact polygons
do not use digitized geometry for the preregistered primary analysis
do not move vertices after seeing tracked goose locations
do not choose among traces based on model fit
do not use climate correlation strength to redraw boundaries
